class Applications
  find_agent_update(request: AgentUpdateRequest) -> AgentUpdateResult
  prepare_agent_update(request: AgentUpdateRequest) -> AgentUpdateResult
  commit_agent_update(intent: str) -> AgentUpdateResult
  set_activation(request: ActivationConfiguration) -> _dependency_facade.ApplicationChange
  reconcile_activation(expected: _dependency_facade.ApplicationDescriptor) -> _dependency_facade.ApplicationChange
  confirm_receiver_start(recipe_digest: str) -> _dependency_facade.ApplicationChange
  read_agent_enrollment(application: str) -> AgentEnrollmentResult
  set_agent_enrollment(request: AgentEnrollmentRequest) -> AgentEnrollmentResult
  register(request: RegisterRequest) -> Change
  ask_confirmation(application: str) -> _dependency_facade.ApplicationChange
  remove(request: ChangeRequest) -> Change
  announce(key: str, presence: _dependency_facade.ApplicationPresence) -> _dependency_facade.ApplicationChange
  withdraw(application: str, instance: str) -> _dependency_facade.ApplicationChange
  observe(query: Query) -> Page
  activate(key: str, request: ActivateRequest) -> ActivationResult
  describe(query: _dependency_appmodel.ApplicationsQuery) -> DescribeResult
  commands(query: _dependency_appmodel.CommandsQuery) -> CommandsResult
  call(key: str, call: _dependency_appmodel.GatewayCall) -> CallResult
  read_sign_in_start() -> SignInStartResult
  request_setup(use: str) -> SetupResult
  receive_setup_request(after: str) -> SetupRequestRead
  report_setup_step(receipt: SetupPresenterReceipt) -> SetupStepReport
